notes.title: Patch notes for version 1.02
notes.content:
Hi, we just updated the game (uploading it now)...here are the changes we made in response to your feedback, thanks for helping us improve the game!

- Double effect of State Housing on Equality removed
- Changed character artist to correct name
- Smoking ban dilemma influenced by stability
- FGM solvable (ends at 0.01)
- Income Tax and Flat Tax now a blended rate
- Replaced "your nation" with gui name of mission in the quarterly report
- Changed Mineral and Oil wealth to only be reduced by economy evolution in the late game, and increased horizon from 25 years to 50
- Altered balance of inputs to urbanisation
- Extremist radicalisation rates reduced to a third of the original, and pool of Women extremists reduced to 10% of their voters
- Reduced immigration's impact on ethnic minorities from +/-70% to +/-20%
